status: derived from Amazon's published GPL source release; NOT verified on any device

source.why_this_tarball: Amazon lists it under 'Kindle (11th Generation - 2024 Release)'; the code names itself: PRODUCT_ROSSINI in drivers/misc/mediatek/hwtcon_v2, BOARD_TYPE_ROSSINI and u-boot_version_rossini.json in U-Boot

soc.value: MediaTek MT8512 family ('MT8110 Bellatrix' platform), 32-bit ARM (Cortex-A7 per mt8512.dtsi PMU node), PSCI 0.2

kernel.compile_flag: PRODUCT_ROSSINI selects Rossini-specific code in the e-ink driver

identification.mechanism: U-Boot reads board_id from idme; characters 3..5 of board_id (the 'tattoo code') select the product. tattoo codes for Rossini: 3M5, 3GM
identification.caveat: from source only; confirm with `idme --board_id`/the device's board_id before trusting it

bootloader.name: U-Boot (2009.08-based tree plus 'UFBL' e-ink loader), eMMC boot
bootloader.boot_flow: `booteink` reads a FIT image from the eMMC partition named "kernel" (DEFAULT_BOOT_PARTITION) and runs bootm with config '#conf-<dtb>'
bootloader.signature_policy: On a locked production device only FIT configurations whose signature node has key-hint 'fireos-production' are verified; everything else is skipped, so a third-party image is not accepted. Secure boot fuse SBC_EN and production fuse AR_EN are read from eFuse (board_is_secure_cpu / board_is_production_device).
bootloader.anti_rollback: enforced for Rossini on locked production devices: FIT property 'anti-rollback-version-<type>' must not be lower than the device's version
bootloader.fastboot: present; getvar unlock_code returns a code derived from the hardware serial; an Amazon-issued unlock is required to leave the locked state; restricted commands are refused on locked hardware (is_restricted_command_on_locked_hw). The unlock verification code (amzn_unlock.h, amzn_fastboot_lockdown.h) is NOT part of the published source.
bootloader.consequence: A normally purchased KT6 will not boot a Rossini kernel unless Amazon unlocks it. This project does not provide and will not include any exploit or unlock bypass.

display.controller: MediaTek HWTCON v2 (hwtcon_v2 module, CONFIG_MTK_HWTCON_V2=m), /dev/fb0, 8 bpp grayscale, line_length = xres_virtual (aligned), several virtual frames
display.panel: 1448 x 1072 (U-Boot panel_1448_1072_info for BOARD_TYPE_ROSSINI); the fb rotation follows the eDP rotate setting from the controller, so portrait use needs a rotation
display.api: include/linux/hwtcon_ioctl_cmd.h: mxcfb-compatible MXCFB_SEND_UPDATE etc. with a different update struct and waveform numbering (implemented in rossini/display/mxcfb.py variant 'hwtcon', ABI compile-checked against the header)
display.waveform_data: loaded by the driver from firmware files (not in the source)

frontlight.driver: drivers/video/backlight/sgm3756_bl.c, backlight class device named after the platform device (expected /sys/class/backlight/sgm3756 - inferred from dev_name(), confirm on device)

pmic.main: ROHM BD71828 (I2C 0x4B) with power-supply driver bd71827-power.c: supplies 'bd71827_ac' and 'bd71827_bat'
pmic.other: Maxim MAX20342 (USB charger detection), TI TMP103 temperature sensor

touch.note: which one is fitted depends on hardware revision

wifi_bt: MediaTek CONSYS combo (consys node in the dts)
usb: MediaTek USB with extcon; gadget stack of kernel 4.9 supports configfs gadgets

storage.emmc: mmc0 user area; U-Boot partition named 'kernel'; remaining partition table not in the source

userland_constraint: kernel 4.9: glibc >= 2.39 (ABI tag 3.2.0) is fine; no musl requirement
